description.value: Reginald Hill Park Reserve is a protected nature reserve managed by the Nature Conservancy of Canada, situated in the Salish Sea region near Sidney, BC. It is part of NCC's broader Salish Sea conservation initiative, preserving native ecosystems and wildlife habitat. Touring cyclists exploring the Gulf Islands area may find it a worthwhile natural attraction to visit.
